events.body: DL-7444 is scheduled for Thursday 4 May and needs a signature. I will be away that day. Could it be moved to Friday 5 May, when I will be at home all day?

DL-7444: a change to 5 May is possible on payment of the date-change fee of 6.50 through the portal. Attempts on 30 Apr and 29 April failed, no one in. 5 May will therefore be the third and final attempt. After a third failed attempt the parcel returns to the sender on the next working day's trunk.

Oxenhale can move DL-7444 to Friday 5 May once the 6.50 date-change fee is paid through the portal. They have told me this will be the third and final attempt, and that after a third failed attempt the parcel goes back to the sender on the next working day. I will pass on the booking once Oxenhale confirms it.
Paid at 12:31, receipt PF-8595. I will be in from 07:00 on Friday.
DL-7444 booked for 5 May, window 10:00 to 12:00. Fee PF-8595 received.
DL-7444 window revised to 'by 21:00' today. Route overrun on van 22.
DL-7444 status 18:02: 'attempt 3 - missed, customer not available'. Under the attempt rule DL-7444 is now set to return to sender on the trunk leaving Destination depot at 06:30 on Monday 8 May.
The tracker changed to 'missed' at 18:02. I have been in the house since before 07:00 and have not left it. No van came into Larch Row and no card was left.

DL-7444: the recipient reports he was home all day on 5 May and that no vehicle attended. He paid the date-change fee (PF-8595) for this date. Please review the 18:02 attempt record before the return to sender proceeds.

events.from: Greer Vexley, Dispatch supervisor, Ashgrove Arc Logistics
events.body: Reviewed, ref DR-8306. Van 22 did not reach Larch Row on 5 May; the 18:02 status was applied in bulk when the route was closed. That is not an attempt and does not count. This corrects our 18:06 message of yesterday: DL-7444 should not go back. I cannot stop it from here. The return order is already in the depot system and only Destination depot can pull it off Monday's 06:30 trunk. They need a hold request in the Depot work queue quoting DR-8306 before the trunk is loaded. Rebooking is for Oxenhale once the hold is on. I rang Mr Drummond at 12:50 and got no answer.

Setting this out in order so nothing is missed. Monday: I asked to move the delivery, was told the fee and that Friday would be the final attempt, and paid. Friday: window 10:00 to 12:00, then changed to by 21:00, then at 18:02 marked missed, though I was at home throughout. Today: a supervisor rang at 12:50 while I was driving. The voicemail said to call back before 13:00. I called at 13:10 and the line was closed for the weekend. The tracker still says 'returning to sender'. Could you tell me whether anything can still be done, or whether it has gone?
